hook.name: SoloHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for SoloFactory-launched token pools that collects ETH-denominated swap fees via delta returns (base fee plus per-token creator buy/sell tax), with time-decaying anti-snipe surcharges in early blocks and deployer-dump surcharges during a configurable window. All fees accrue 100% to the token creator and are claimable as ETH.
